claims.content: To generate Bi-Month or Monthly financial and medical reports for provider reimbursement based on validated claims.

goal.raw_text: To generate Bi-Month or Monthly financial and medical reports for provider reimbursement based on validated claims.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
The claim form has been validated manually and through the system by the field office.

Claims have passed quarantine verification — either no mandatory information was missed or false information existed, or if quarantined, they were returned by VSP with satisfactory details and entered into the system in the following month’s batch.
Payment terms have been agreed upon by VSP.
Voucher numbers have been generated, printed as bar-codes, and tracked through distribution, retail sales, point of treatment, and claims processing stages.
Client feedback documents (if collected) have been sent to the field office and entered into the database.
Based on the payment terms agreed by VSP, the field office will generate Bi-Month or Monthly financial and medical report and send it to MSIU Admin team to arrange the payments for the VSP.

trigger.raw_text: Based on the payment terms agreed by VSP, the field office will generate Bi-Month or Monthly financial and medical report and send it to MSIU Admin team to arrange the payments for the VSP.

claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User initiates the generation of provider reimbursement reports based on validated claims.
The system generates a monthly report after claim collection on clean claims to be paid without reservation.
The system generates a monthly report after claim collection on claims where payment shall be withheld until clarification.
The system generates a report on claims per provider.

If any mandatory information is missed or false information exists in a claim, the field office rejects the claim back to VSP and keeps it in quarantine; if VSP returns satisfactory details, the claim is entered into the system in the following month’s batch — affecting which claims are included in the current reimbursement report.

The user must enter the correct Voucher No; incorrect entry may lead to inaccurate population of associated data (syndromes, lab tests, drugs, treatment success, referral, partner treated) in reports.

Reports can be generated as Standard or Customized per the MSIU Project Document named 'Programme Design Study'; deviation from standard formats may require manual adjustment or clarification before finalizing reimbursement.

If any mandatory information is missed or any false information exists in a claim form during validation, the field office rejects the claim back to VSP and the system keeps those claims in a quarantine area.

Quarantined forms are sent back to the VSP for verification; if the VSP does not return the claim with satisfactory details, the claim remains excluded from the current reimbursement report generation cycle.
Bi-Month or Monthly financial and medical reports have been generated by the field office based on validated claims.
The generated reports have been sent to the MSIU Admin team to arrange payments for the VSP.
